name: Short Cut Sweet Chili Chicken with Fried Rice & Brussels Sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Place water, butter, and rice mix in a medium saucepan, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to medium-low. Cook until tender, 7-10 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit 2 minutes, then fluff with a fork before serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 (5.7 oz) pkg fried rice kit

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Pat the chicken dry with paper towels, then season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 oz chicken breast tenders
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Add sauce, turn chicken to coat, and continue to cook until heated through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
¼ cup sweet chili sauce

instructions.primary_message: While the chicken is cooking, place Brussels sprout bag on a microwave-safe plate and pierce with a fork. Place in the microwave and cook on high, until tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove plate from microwave and carefully open the bag.
To serve, divide rice, chicken, sauce, and Brussels sprouts between plates. Dot sprouts with butter, then season with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper
